Final green head for L1 (2026-11-24T19:56Z): `5615c99dbc2c1389dadaf8598c48d2021c34045a`.

- Checks at this head: the check suites completed with none failing (45 success, 13 skipped per the dev's read; the relay's suite-completed event agrees). The body was rewritten by the seat after the fix round, so the PR-body guard reruns on that edit; L1 reads it at its own pass.
- Scope: the claim's file surface was widened in comment 7140909062 on #37027 to fold the phone sort sheet in (same defect, same keys). No new published export; `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- Seat's call on the dev's open question (dead `sortBuilder.*` locale rows): **leave them** (option A). Removing rows from the published `@object-ui/i18n` packs is a narrowing, which this p2 wording fix does not carry; the seat withdraws its own fix-round item that asked for removal. Noted, not filed: a removal with a declared narrowing has no pull today.
- Points for L1: the wording rule now lives twice (module-local in `@object-ui/components`, and plugin-list's internal condition model), stated in the body as the price of not widening the published surface; browser check NOT MEASURED (verify lock held by other runs both rounds) — the DOM tests drive the real SortBuilder and phone `ListView`, each with a recorded fails-before.

repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ

## 席位核对 — REWORK · L1 · head `5615c99dbc2c1389dadaf8598c48d2021c34045a` · 2026-11-24T20:06Z

Requested by zone a4-C (7142827731) for card #37027.

Delivered and correct: the sort builder reads number fields 小 → 大 / 大 → 小 through a module-local direction helper (`ui/packages/components/src/custom/sort-builder.tsx`), and the phone sort panel now calls the one plugin-list helper (`conditionModel.ts`); dates still read as time and text as the alphabet, pinned by controls on both surfaces; the two copies of the rule are equivalent and the trade-off is stated; no published export added or removed (plugin-list exports only `.`). Keeping the four now-unread `sortBuilder.*` pack rows (the zone's A) is right — removing them would narrow the published pack. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, patch: right. Check-runs: 47 success, 15 expected skip, 0 failed; the latest `PR-body guards` run (after the body rewrite) passed.

M1 (must-fix) — this PR is the first to show the `listConditions.sort.*` rows to users, and the Arabic alphabet pair reads backwards: `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/ar.ts` `alphabet_asc: 'A ← Z'`, `alphabet_desc: 'Z ← A'`. Between two Latin letters the run is left-to-right even on an RTL page, so the ascending option displays as "A ← Z" (Z to A). Before this PR Arabic users saw the correct `A → Z` from `sortBuilder.ascending`. Fix: `'A → Z'` / `'Z → A'`, add `'@object-ui/i18n': patch` to the changeset (key set unchanged, `Clause-②: no` holds). The Arabic-script time and size rows are fine.
S1 (should-fix) — every assertion runs on the built-in English defaults; nothing pins the card's zh 「小 → 大」 or the Arabic pair. Add a case mounted under the real `I18nProvider` for zh and ar on the builder (precedent `ariaLabelNames.zh-12145.test.tsx`); ablate M1's fix → red.
S2 (should-fix) — the changeset should say that the four `sortBuilder.*` direction rows are no longer read (a host that overrode them now overrides `listConditions.sort.*`), and that ja, ko and ru date/text wording changes.

Nits: N1 the describe title "from the chip's own table" (`sort-builder-date-direction-duplicates-27520.test.tsx`) is out of date; N2 one row each pinning boolean → size and time → time on both surfaces would also catch the two copies drifting; N3 PR title scope covers components only; N4 add a pointer in `sort-builder.tsx` to its twin in `conditionModel.ts`.

Landing K: 26 since the merge base — merge `main` in the rework round. Delta L1 on the new head.
